artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundary where the ice cream meets the cake is somewhat muddy and indistinct. The ice cream seems to fuse into the cake pores without a clear physical separation or realistic compression of the cake surface.

The spoon handle enters the frame at an angle that feels slightly disconnected from the bowl of the spoon (which is obscured), and the reflection on it is minimal compared to the strong lighting on the ice cream.

Physical interaction between ice cream and cake (melting/compression)
